lines: Good afternoon. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.
Prime Minister Mark Carney and his European Union counterparts are closing a major summit by announcing what they call an alliance for the future, The Canadian Press reports.

From tariff powers to trade leverage, Washington political analyst Eric Ham breaks down everything Canadians need to know ahead of next week’s crucial U.S. midterm elections, The Canadian Press reports.

Evacuees from Russian-occupied Oleshky began the long journey out of the war-ravaged region in bus convoys Friday, on the fourth day of the most significant truce since Russia’s full-scale invasion of Ukraine four-and-a-half years ago, The Associated Press reports.

Leo XIV has become the first pope to vote in a U.S. general election, casting a mail-in ballot in a contest that will decide America’s future as the Trump era slowly comes to an end, The Associated Press reports.

Christa Pike said Friday that she remains in constant pain and struggles to speak a month after surviving a lethal injection in Tennessee, a failure she blames on “incompetence,” The Associated Press reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
